title: Sustainability and Environmental Impact Report
description: Il Rapporto sulla sostenibilità e l’impatto ambientale è uno strumento adottato per monitorare i risultati e pianificare le misure da attuare nell’ambito della sostenibilità ambientale, sociale ed economica dell’USI.

blocks.html:
The Sustainability and Environmental Impact Report is a tool adopted to monitor outcomes and plan measures to be implemented in the environmental, social, and economic sustainability efforts of USI.

Published every two years, it is a concise, clear, and comprehensive document outlining USI's objectives and strategies in economic, environmental, and social domains. The report serves as an important resource for internal and external stakeholders to stay informed about the progress toward the set goals. Through transparency, a public institution like the Università della Svizzera italiana establishes a relationship of trust with its citizens and the community in which it operates.
